items.claim: Suspending a journal while a journal inside it is active
items.note: `suspend` now throws in that case. Strict call, recorded in `docs/unruled.md` in f038878081.

items.claim: Parent `apply`/`applyOps`/`recordEntry`/`restore` running under an active journal
items.note: Strict call, recorded in `docs/unruled.md` in f038878081.

items.claim: Raw history's mutators not refusing under an active journal
items.note: for `apply`, `applyOps`, `recordEntry` and `restore`. Not a defect for `clear`, `prune`, `dropRedo` and `switchBranch`: none of them leaves an entry describing a state the document is not in. That choice is recorded in `docs/unruled.md`.

items.claim: A throwing `selection.set` during undo/redo leaving the entry on its old stack
items.note: The entry now moves before its selection is restored, and undo/redo report what moved even when they throw.

items.claim: Empty restored branch making `branches()`/`switchBranch()` throw TypeError
A goto whose walk back also throws not telling `observe`
Restore not bumping `nextEntryId` past the floor and fork points
Suspend leaving the inner journal active
Cancel unwinding children in the order they were opened
items.note: Children are now unwound latest edit first. Edits interleaved between suspended siblings still can't be unwound exactly in any order; that is recorded as Open in `docs/unruled.md`. The second point, two children active at once during cancel, is not a defect: it lasts only inside `cancel` and ends with every child closed.

items.claim: `undo`/`redo` skipping the journal refusal on an empty stack
items.note: `goto` to the current depth now refuses too.
